description: Source code for certificate verification utility functions, including certificate chain dumping, verification, and result printing, used within Chromium's network security components.

classes.name: StringToConstant
classes.description: Associates a human-readable name with an integer constant for decoding bitmask values.

methods.name: DumpX509CertificateChain
methods.description: Writes a PEM-encoded chain of the given certificate to a file.

methods.name: PrintCertStatus
methods.description: Prints the certificate status flags in a human-readable format.

methods.name: PrintCertVerifyResult
methods.description: Prints detailed verification results including status flags and certificate chain info.

methods.name: VerifyUsingCertVerifyProc
methods.description: Performs certificate verification using a specified verification procedure, outputs results, and optionally dumps the certificate chain.
